title: Za'atar & Orange Roast Chicken with Lemon Roast Potatoes
description: A whole chicken roasted with an orange in the cavity and a za'atar-spiced skin, served with lemon and garlic roast potatoes.
ingredients: 1 garlic bulb, cloves separated with skins on
steps: Prick orange all over; insert into chicken cavity. Place chicken in a roasting tin; sprinkle Za'atar over skin; spray all over. Cover with foil; roast on middle shelf for 1 hour.
Parboil potatoes: cover with cold water, bring to boil, simmer 10 minutes until slightly soft on outside. Drain; shake in pan with lid to roughen outsides.
Pour chicken stock over potatoes; grate lemon zest over; season with salt and pepper; spray with cooking spray.
After 1 hour, uncover chicken. Arrange potatoes and garlic cloves around the chicken. Squeeze lemon juice over potatoes.
Roast uncovered for 45 minutes until chicken is golden and juices run clear.
notes: Za'atar can be bought ready-mixed or made at home (see p.213).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
